summary: Fixed both B&S methods to mask the unavailable area of every Method triangle and aligned the Details tab with the other method pages.
details: Cells outside the annual triangle no longer print 0: they show no value and no grid line, matching the Dataset Viewer.
A cell with no calculated value inside the triangle is blank instead of 0.
Details pickers moved inside their field, the Decimal Places spinner no longer stretches the full width, and the source groups use the standard spacing.
